name: Shirogane
source:
Eldest child of the Oushuu Fujiwara family. A retainer of Fujiwara no Yasuhira.
A refined youth whose temperment is quite reserved.
He's on the side of the Priestess.
He rather resembles the Taira general Taira no Tomomori.

[Spoiler] His real name is Taira no Shigehira.[/Spoiler]
